protocol.splits: same saved contract-level train/calibration/evaluation IDs as each paired TF-IDF run
protocol.thresholds: both systems fit per-category thresholds on calibration predictions only
protocol.macro_f1: fixed 41-category macro; zero-support categories contribute F1=0
protocol.macro_aupr: mean over categories with at least one evaluation positive
protocol.bootstrap: paired resampling of evaluation contracts with replacement; thresholds stay fixed
protocol.interpretation: five-seed summary is descriptive; seeded evaluation sets overlap and are not independent
